text:
**Short answer:** For most iPhone drivers, get the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount. If you want the fastest charging, get the Anker Prime. For the best value, get the ESR HaloLock.

**Top picks**

1. **Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (Qi2, 15W), about $47.99.** It's the best all-rounder. It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape. Check your vents first: Belkin's support docs say slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats fit best. ([RottenWiFi review](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

2. **Anker Prime Wireless Car Charger (MagGo, AirCool, Qi2 25W), $89.99.** It has the fastest charging and active cooling (thermoelectric plus fan). MountGuys uses it as their daily driver, and Anker's clip is more secure than Belkin's or Apple's. The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale. Some caveats:
   - Anker says it's not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or cars without standard vent blades.
   - Full 25W only works with newer iPhones: up to 25W on iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus, 22W on iPhone 16 and 16 Pro, and about 15W on iPhone 15 and earlier.
   - It needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter. MountGuys and The Gadgeteer both say a 60W adapter comes in the box.
   - [MountGuys review](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) · [The Gadgeteer roundup](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

3. **ESR HaloLock 15W Wireless Car Charger with CryoBoost, $39.99 list.** It's the best value, with Qi2 15W and a cooling fan to help avoid heat throttling on sunny dashboards. A tested code, **PARTNER18**, brings it to **$32.80** (checked in ESR's cart on 2026-10-25). Buy here: [ESR HaloLock 15W via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through that link, at no extra cost to you. The Gadgeteer notes an 18W car adapter isn't included, which could add $10 to $15.

4. **If you don't want a charging cable on the vent:** The VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount is a non-charging magnetic mount with a metal-core clip. MountGuys picked it from research rather than hands-on testing. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))

**Quick tips**
- Look for **Qi2 certification**. "MagSafe-compatible" without it may only charge at 7.5W.
- Ignore big "gf" or "lb suction" claims on cheap listings. They often describe the suction cup, not the magnetic hold.
- Android users need a MagSafe or Qi2 magnetic case for any of these.
- If your vents are poor, Belkin also makes a vent/dash version at $47.99. ([iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

The search results didn't include direct product-page URLs for Belkin or Anker. The review pages linked above have the Amazon buy buttons. Tell me your phone and car, and I can narrow it to one pick.
